notes.families: MODE: grid — S1 renders a single review and would drop two of the three, so the pick is S2 (grid on a band) or S3 (grid beside the heading). The two unattributed star-rating quotes in the migrated body are NOT carried; see `dropped.text`.
notes.kennel-club: No licence number and no statutory claim: scripts/placeholder_check.py holds LICENCE_CLAIM_PLACEHOLDER / LEGAL_CLAIM_PLACEHOLDER until the breeder confirms the wording (CLAUDE.md rule 9, Known Issue 7).
notes.paperwork-proof: MODE: single — pick S1, which is the only reviews style that renders one review (src/lib/boardStyles.ts: S1 mode 'single', S2 and S3 mode 'grid'). Slot filled with data/reviews.json entry 2, Mark J (London). Entry 2 is also one of the three in the 'families' grid at n=8; it is repeated deliberately, because it is the only review that speaks to health testing and the grid has to show all three.
notes.puppies: The one embed the migrated page carried (YouTube fXhu9jDS6CA) is kept here at its original id; the record does not describe what is in it, because no file on disk says. facts_preserved_check.py gates the id.
notes.questions: A fifth row, "Who will I be dealing with?", was written and then NOT kept: its answer leans on Lisa Bright and on Carlisle, and neither word is in the migrated body, so tests/py/test_faq_data.py could not verify it against a source until P5 rewrites the page. It belongs on this page and should be added with the rebuild. Query augmentation for 'blue staffy uk breeders', mapped: q1 -> top and our-story; q2 and q3 -> health-testing and the about-health-tests FAQ row; q4 -> home-raising and the about-home-raised row; q5 -> kennel-club; q6 and q8 -> delivery; q7 -> delivery and puppies.
notes.top: No CTA and no links in the hero: the kit Hero's buttons and trust chips default to NONE (spec §9 amendment 6a) and this record gives it neither.
notes.video-our-home: VideoEmbed is component 18 and the three styles are its frame and play axes: S1 the player in a card with the caption beneath it, S2 the player full width on a steel band, S3 the click-to-play facade. S3 is the lightest and is what the page takes unless the board picks otherwise; all three reserve the same 16:9 box (working rule 14). NOTE ON THE FRAMES: the board's preview iframes are fully sandboxed, so the YouTube player inside S1 and S2 stays blank — what those two frames show is the BED (a card, a steel band) and the reserved 16:9 box, which is what the two arrangements differ by. S3 renders in full, thumbnail and play button.
notes.welcome: A standard section: no shell and no form. The migrated page put a reservation form here; the enquiry form on this site lives on /uk-blue-staffy-breeders-contact/, which this section links, so the form's own label and its 24-hour promise are dropped rather than rebuilt.
